key_insight: An uncertainty-conditioned framework turns genomic model predictions into traceable, graph-supported phenotype hypotheses, with hypothesis breadth reflecting upstream uncertainty.
clinical_relevance: The approach could support research prioritization of phenotype hypotheses from genomic evidence, but clinical utility is not established.
method: Score admissible gene–disease–phenotype paths with an interpretable learned energy model.
Use calibrated predictive uncertainty to control the temperature of path probability distributions.
Aggregate path probabilities into phenotype hypotheses without patient-level phenotype supervision.
evidence_signal: On AlzKB and Hetionet, phenotype entropy tracked upstream uncertainty (Spearman 0.951 and 0.878); gene-holdout recall@10 exceeded trained DistMult on 24 of 30 graph masks (0.183 versus 0.123).
watch_item: The gene-holdout advantage was driven mainly by three genes with many variants and is not established across all genes.
paper_title: From Sequence Uncertainty to Phenotype Hypotheses: Uncertainty-Conditioned Inference over Biomedical Knowledge Graphs
